t: This is St James's, Spanish Place, a large English Gothic Catholic church on George Street in Marylebone. It's a Grade II* listed building, designed by the church architect Edward Goldie. The name Spanish Place comes from the road opposite, a reminder of the church's historic connection with the Spanish Embassy. It's dedicated to Saint James the Elder, one of the Twelve Apostles, who is the patron saint of Spain, which fits that Spanish link.
